market_summary: All five monitored symbols (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD) are currently in mature post-expansion consolidation phases during the late New York session. Across the board, assets are positioned below their respective session VWAP, EMA50, and Value Area Lows following earlier downward expansions. However, current price action is characterized by sub-1.0 RVOL (grey bars), stalled or neutral CVD momentum, and mean-reverting bounces off session lows into intermediate EMA20/mid-channel levels. With no active yellow RVOL breakout signals or clean liquidity sweep-and-reject triggers, strict discipline warrants HOLD across all symbols until fresh directional volume emerges.
